comments.author: participant4
comments.body:
@reporter Could you try to add a `security_opt` like this:
```
 standalone:
    container_name: milvus-standalone
    image: milvusdb/milvus:v2.3.0
    command: ["milvus", "run", "standalone"]
    security_opt:
    - seccomp:unconfined 
```
https://github.com/milvus-io/milvus/issues/27028 has fixed the `Operation not permitted` error by adding `security_opt`.

comments.author: participant4
comments.body:
`seccomp` (Secure computing mode) is a Linux kernel feature. It can be used to limit which `systemcalls` can be issued from the docker application. 

Read more from: https://docs.docker.com/engine/security/seccomp/
